question: When the difference between compound interest, compounded annually, and simple interest for three years is ₹152 at 4% interest per annum, the principal is ₹_____.
solution:
**Given:**

Difference between CI and SI for 3 years = ₹152

Rate (r) = 4% per annum

Time (t) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Difference = P × dfrac{r²(300+r)}{100³}

**Calculations:**

152 = P × dfrac{4²(300+4)}{100³}

⇒ 152 = P × dfrac{16 × 304}{1000000}

⇒ 152 = P × dfrac{4864}{1000000}

⇒ 152 = P × 0.004864

⇒ P = 152 ÷ 0.004864

⇒ P = 31250

**∴ The principal is ₹31,250.**
